title: KnowledgeRelations
description: Design proposal, not yet implemented (Phase 9). Directed edges between knowledge items (and, for 'illustrates', a figure and a knowledge item), stored SEPARATELY from the normalized JSON and the enrichment file -- never merged into either. See knowledge_relations.md for full rationale and the deterministic/rule-based/LLM classification of every relation type.

RelationType.description: v1 is deliberately two types only -- see knowledge_relations.md §1/§8 for why 'shares_concept' and 'prerequisite_of' were considered and NOT included.

Confidence.description: Admin-facing tier only -- mirrors figure_knowledge_association.md's CONFIDENCE_BY_DECISION philosophy. The underlying reading-order distance or association score is in `signals`, never surfaced as a raw number to a non-technical reviewer.

GenerationMethod.description: Same convention as knowledge_enrichment.schema.json's GenerationMethod, plus 'human_confirmed' for a relation whose target was a human review decision (Figure Knowledge Review), not an algorithm output at all.

RelationSignals.description: Explainable, field-specific evidence for one relation -- never hidden inside a single opaque score.

source_review_status.description: For 'illustrates': the Figure Knowledge Review status this relation was derived from (e.g. CONFIRMED, REASSIGNED), or the association decision (AUTO_MATCH) if no human review exists yet.

relation_id.description: Deterministic: 'rel-<chapter_id>-<type>-<source_id>-<target_id>' -- content-derived, never a counter, so a rerun with unchanged inputs produces the identical id.

review_status.description: 'NOT_REQUIRED' only for a high-confidence deterministic/rule_based relation. A 'human_confirmed' relation is already HUMAN_APPROVED (the human review IS the confirmation). Low-confidence rule_based relations and any future llm-generated relation must be at least REVIEW_REQUIRED -- never silently trusted, same convention as every prior phase.
